build_occupancy_grid: build an occupancy grid from a pickled point cloud file with configurable scale
filter_and_visualize_pcd: filter and visualize a 3D point cloud using Open3D with z-axis thresholding
map_x_from_cg_to_grid: map an x coordinate from center of gravity space to grid coordinates
map_y_from_cg_to_grid: map a y coordinate from center of gravity space to grid coordinates
run_occupancy_grid_main: run the main script to generate and save an occupancy grid image from a PCD file
